subject: Apply V4 market-scope assert
description: Add an explicit assert that exactly one market_id resolves for DVH EXCL. HD. Current code guards len==0 but not len>1, so a duplicate id would silently reintroduce the 6.16x double-count. Failure must be loud and early.
outcome: V4a at :183-193 (CSV path raises on len>1). V4b at :77-101 (DB path pre-flight id count) added beyond literal scope and kept -- that SQL filters a joined dim_market, so a duplicate description fans out the JOIN and every SUM() double-counts.
